hypothesis: H-FILEFEAT: the leaderboard score of a raster is predictable from its own placement statistics (dot count, spacing, clustering, distance to the published catalogue, and mean geophysical values under its dots)
what_was_run: ridge regression with 128 rows and 3-11 features, leave-one-out, on: log(dot count), fraction of dots within 3 px and 10 px of the catalogue, mean distance to the catalogue, dot clustering density, and the mean of six feature-stack bands under the dots
why_it_failed: the score distribution is driven by a handful of catastrophic outliers (0.0000, 0.0005, 0.0009, 0.0020) that no file-level summary anticipates; every feature set is worse than predicting the mean and only recovers rank, not magnitude
what_was_kept: the rank signal is real (rho up to 0.74), so the covariates are recorded as the starting point for H-CELLDISTILL, which uses them at cell level with the corpus-derived labels rather than at file level
stopped_after: one feature sweep; no submission slot used
